Lesson 33. Major vs. Minor

Intervals a half step smaller than major are called minor. Lowering the upper note by a half step will form a minor interval from a major one.

Major Minor Major Minor Major Minor Major Minor 2nd 2nd 3rd 3rd 6th 6th 7th 7th

Raising the lower note by a half step will also form a minor interval from a major one.

M2 m2 M3 m3 M6 m6 M7 m7

Practice

1. Write the indicated major interval then the minor interval above each given note.

M2 m2 M3 m3 M6 m6 M7 m7

2. Write the indicated major interval then the minor interval below each given note.

M2 m2 M3 m3 M6 m6 M7 m7

3. Identify each interval with its complete name.
